<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1929776_compli_0.CPMSync</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CPMSync</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CPMSync = Class.create();
CPMSync.prototype = {
  initialize: function() {
    this.util = new CPMUtil();
  },

  run: function() {
    this.ensurePosture();
    var control = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_control');
    control.query();
    while (control.next()) this.syncControl(control);
  },

  runForControl: function(control) {
    this.ensurePosture();
    this.syncControl(control);
  },

  ensurePosture: function() {
    var have = {};
    var posture = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_service_posture');
    posture.query();
    while (posture.next()) have[posture.getValue('business_service')] = true;

    var service = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_service');
    var query = this.util.serviceQuery();
    if (query) service.addEncodedQuery(query);
    service.query();
    while (service.next()) {
      if (have[service.getUniqueValue()]) continue;
      var row = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_service_posture');
      row.initialize();
      row.setValue('business_service', service.getUniqueValue());
      row.insert();
    }
  },

  syncControl: function(control) {
    var isAutomatic = control.getValue('method') == 'automatic';
    var services = this._matchingServices(control);
    var passing = isAutomatic ? this._passingServices(control) : {};

    var existing = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_service_control');
    existing.addQuery('control', control.getUniqueValue());
    existing.query();
    var seen = {};
    while (existing.next()) {
      var serviceId = existing.getValue('business_service');
      seen[serviceId] = true;
      this._refresh(existing, services[serviceId], isAutomatic, passing[serviceId]);
    }
    for (var id in services) {
      if (!seen[id]) this._create(control.getUniqueValue(), id, services[id], isAutomatic && passing[id]);
    }
  },

  _controlQuery: function(control, extra) {
    return this.util.serviceQuery([control.getValue('applies_to'), extra]);
  },

  // { serviceId: ownerId } for every service the control applies to
  _matchingServices: function(control) {
    var out = {};
    if (control.getValue('active') != '1') return out;
    var service = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_service');
    var query = this._controlQuery(control);
    if (query) service.addEncodedQuery(query);
    service.query();
    while (service.next()) out[service.getUniqueValue()] = this.util.ownerOf(service);
    return out;
  },

  // { serviceId: true } for the services that pass an automatic control
  _passingServices: function(control) {
    var out = {};
    var pass = control.getValue('pass_condition');
    if (!pass || control.getValue('active') != '1') return out;
    var service = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_service');
    service.addEncodedQuery(this._controlQuery(control, pass));
    service.query();
    while (service.next()) out[service.getUniqueValue()] = true;
    return out;
  },

  _refresh: function(record, owner, isAutomatic, passes) {
    var applies = owner !== undefined;
    var want = { active: applies ? '1' : '0' };
    if (applies) {
      want.owner = owner;
      if (isAutomatic) {
        want.state = passes ? 'valid' : 'missing';
        want.valid_until = '';
        want.evidence = '';
        if (passes) want.notified_state = '';
      } else if (!record.getValue('valid_until')) {
        want.state = 'missing';
      }
    }
    this._apply(record, want);
  },

  _create: function(controlId, serviceId, owner, passes) {
    var record = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_service_control');
    record.initialize();
    record.setValue('control', controlId);
    record.setValue('business_service', serviceId);
    record.setValue('owner', owner);
    record.setValue('active', true);
    record.setValue('state', passes ? 'valid' : 'missing');
    record.insert();
  },

  // Writes only what changed
  _apply: function(record, want) {
    var changed = false;
    for (var field in want) {
      if ((record.getValue(field) || '') !== want[field]) {
        record.setValue(field, want[field]);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (changed) record.update();
  },

  type: 'CPMSync'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-24 11:46:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>ddf63a3e73001310a621f2024ab8b7fe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CPMSync</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper" source="x_1929776_compli_0">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_ddf63a3e73001310a621f2024ab8b7fe</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-24 11:46:21</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
